manual.note: datasheet only; the standard K15 DMX chart was NOT obtained (claypaky.it links to e-assist.tech, login; two manual hosts refused automated reading). The K15 AQUA chart is a different variant and is NOT copied in as this lamp

howToRead: the K15 channel lists are OWED: modes carry their footprint from the datasheet only. Nothing here is a K15 channel.
owed: the standard K15 DMX chart (claypaky.it / e-assist.tech, login) for Standard, Shape, Standard + Freq, Shape + Freq and the Pixel engine
reference_only: The K15 AQUA chart (a different variant, source CP-K15-AQUA) counts Standard 21 / Standard Freq 22 / Shape 35 / Shape Freq 36 / pixels 57 / 76. It is NOT this lamp and no channel of it is carried; it only shows why 22 and 36 are probably the Freq variants.

22.name: Basic (22 per datasheet)
22.note: From the datasheet's '22/36/57/76 DMX channels' only. CHANNEL LIST OWED: the standard K15 DMX chart sits behind the maker's login (claypaky.it -> e-assist.tech). 22 is probably Standard + Freq (the AQUA sheet counts Standard 21 / Standard Freq 22): an inference, not read.

36.name: Shape (36 per datasheet)
36.note: From the datasheet only. CHANNEL LIST OWED. Probably Shape + Freq (AQUA: Shape 35 / Shape Freq 36): an inference, not read.

57.name: Pixel RGB
57.note: From the datasheet only. CHANNEL LIST OWED. Pixel engine, own address (user menu 02.2022); pixels only, no pan / tilt / zoom - inferred from the menu structure and the K10 manual, not read for the K15.

76.name: Pixel RGBW
76.note: From the datasheet only. CHANNEL LIST OWED. Pixel engine RGBW, 19 x 4; pixels only (inferred, as above).

112.name: Shape + Pixel RGBW
112.note: The combined mode the Platina plan uses: the 36-channel basic list followed by the 76-channel pixel list = 112, two engines addressed side by side (pixel address = basic address + 36). LIST OWED with the two it is made of.
